content.body: Can you sketch the agenda for the planning week?

Here is a first pass at the planning week.

- **Monday:** goals review and the roadmap walk-through, with time set aside for questions from each team.
- **Tuesday:** working sessions by area, then a short readout at the end of the day.
- **Wednesday:** customer interviews in the morning and synthesis in the afternoon.

I kept Thursday and Friday open so the plan can absorb whatever the interviews turn up.
Who should run the Tuesday readout?

The readout works best with one host per area, so each team presents its own findings. Pick someone who joined the working sessions, since they can answer follow-up questions without handing off. If you want a single facilitator to keep time, the person running the planning week is the natural choice, and they can introduce each area in a sentence or two.
Add a reminder the day before each session.

Done. Each session now has a reminder at 9:00 AM the day before, sent to everyone invited. The Monday reminder goes out on Friday, since nobody reads email on Sunday. You can change the time on any single reminder without touching the others.

Three things are still open:

1. The room for the Wednesday interviews, which needs to seat eight.
2. Whether the readout is recorded for people who cannot attend.
3. The lunch order for Tuesday, which needs a headcount by Monday noon.

Everything else on the plan has an owner and a date.

Also: add the team offsite on Thursday at 10am at the north office.

And

The follow-up review on Friday at 2pm, in the large meeting room on the third floor.
